summary: Would you like to relax to the pitter-patter of rain?
description:
Google Play Indie Games Festival Top 20 Winner Starring Ai Fairooz

Would you like to be healed while listening to the sound of rain?

This is a game in which you watch the rain falling in the countryside.

When you sleep, meditate, concentrate, or study, listening to the sound of rain will calm your mind and relax you.

You can release the story by consuming a certain amount of points.

I recommend this game to people like this.
People who like rainy days and want to listen to the sound of rain all the time.
People who want to be free from daily stress.
People who want to talk with cute girls.
People who like to play leave it alone games.
People who want to listen to piano music or guitar music.
People who want to study English words.
If you like Monster Company - Real-time Nurturing Simulation, Healing Jellyfish - Free Nurturing Game, Lost Decade, Ark Knights, Houseki no Jyutaku - Completely free and relaxing game, Haguruma no Machi - Free and relaxing game of left-alone spinning, Abyssium, Uncrown, ALTER EGO, World for Two

Benefits of listening to the sound of rain

Relaxing Effect
The sound of rain is relaxing for many people. The calm, rhythmic sound is pleasant and may help reduce stress. It is especially useful when you want to relax or improve your concentration.

Sleep aid
The sound of rain is one of the natural sounds used to aid sleep. The quiet, peaceful sound of rain may help induce sleep. It is especially helpful as white noise used to block out outside noise during sleep.

Improved Concentration
The sound of rain may aid in improving concentration. It may improve creativity and work efficiency by blocking out ambient noise and creating an environment conducive to concentration. Use the sound of rain as background noise during tasks or studies that require concentration.

Connection to Nature
Listening to the sound of rain can help you feel connected to nature. It can be refreshing to be away from the hustle and bustle of the city and to feel the presence of nature. Nature sounds are believed to have a positive effect on physical and mental health, and the sound of rain is one such sound.

Use of Music and Sound Effects
Rain sounds may be used in music production and sound effects creation. Used in the background of movies and music, they can enhance the atmosphere and emotional expression.

Advantages of Playing Neglected Games

Easy entertainment
Abandonment games are a simple pastime that can be easily enjoyed. They can be played to pass the time or relax while following the progress and achievements in the game. It can be used as a short break or a change of pace, especially in our busy daily lives.

Automatic progression
Neglected games basically progress automatically. After the player initially sets the action in the game, he or she then simply waits and progresses. This feature of automatic progression allows the game to proceed while doing other tasks or activities. For example, players can play while working or studying.

Economical
Many abandonment games are offered for free. While in-app purchases may exist for some games, basic gameplay is free. Thus, they can be used economically as easily accessible entertainment.

Sense of accomplishment and progress
Abandoned games continue to progress while the player is away, so that when he or she returns, a sense of accomplishment and progress can be felt. Progress such as achieving in-game goals, collecting items, and leveling up provides a sense of accomplishment and satisfaction.

Collection Elements
Neglected games have an item collection element. Players can collect and develop various items and characters. This collection element can motivate long-term game play and goal achievement.
